name: Crucifixion

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Roman penal apparatus and the theological necessity of the atonement

VINIT.justification: The unmanifest state prior to the historical event of the passion

TANCH.justification: The final boundary that contains and concludes the sacrificial narrative

AFWD.justification: The directed movement toward the site of execution

AREV.justification: The voluntary descent and self-emptying of the divine into suffering

CLINK.justification: The sequential transition from trial to physical execution

IMSCRIB.justification: The identification and recognition of the subject as the specific sacrificial victim

FSPLIT.justification: The division of the human response into the penitent and the impenitent

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of all human moral states into a single judicial resolution

EVALT.justification: The affirmative response to the penitent thief

EVALF.justification: The rejection and mockery by the impenitent thief and the crowd

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous experience of divine union and divine abandonment

IFIX.justification: The permanent written record of the charge fixed to the cross

phase_3.void_description: The silence before the arrest in Gethsemane
phase_3.true_description: The acceptance of the cup and the fulfillment of the law
phase_3.false_description: The rejection of the messianic claim and the execution of the sentence
phase_3.both_description: The God-Man suffering death while remaining the source of life

steps.domain_action: The Logos exists in the unmanifest state before the passion
The subject identifies with the role of the sacrificial lamb
The movement toward the Praetorium begins
The judicial sentence links the trial to the execution
The Roman authorities record the permanent charge on the titulus
The subject descends into the physical weight of the cross
The presence of the two thieves branches the human response
The penitent thief receives the promise of paradise
The impenitent thief expresses the state of rejection
The totality of human response is gathered into the singular event
The subject experiences the paradox of the Eli Eli Lama Sabachthani
The final breath fixes the event in history as Tetelestai
The burial in the tomb seals the system boundary

phase_5.memory_mechanism: The Apostolic Tradition and the Gospels

phase_6.cycle_cost: The physical life of the subject
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: The state of legal condemnation and spiritual debt
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The state of propitiation and the potential for resurrection
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The death is a substitutionary exchange that preserves the moral order
